Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 안녕~ 스타 세이비어의 신규 컷신 시스템 확인용 시나리오야~
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Hello~ It's a new cutscene system test scenario for Star Savior~
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 你好~ 这是星际救世者的新的截图系统确认用场景~

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 바뀐 카메라들을 쭉 보여줄테니 이상 없는지 확인하도록!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Show me all the changed cameras so I can make sure everything is okay!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我会把所有更换过的摄像头都展示给你，你确认一下是否一切正常！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I am at POS3 right now.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我现在站的地方是POS3。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: It's in the middle!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 在中间位置！

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 단독 캐릭터가 등장할때는 이 위치가 기본이겠지?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: When a single character appears, this position would be the default, right?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 當單獨角色出現時，這個位置應該是預設的吧？

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Then I'll call one more person!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 那好，我再叫一个人过来！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Oh, is this a screen for two people to come out?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 哦哦！這是一個顯示兩個人的畫面嗎！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The camera is in DEFAULT state right now!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 相机现在处于默认状态！

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 가장 기본값 카메라로, 화면 정중앙을 비추는 카메라 값이지!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The camera with the default value, which illuminates the center of the screen!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 使用默认相机，以屏幕中心为焦点的相机值！

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 그럼 불러낼 수 있는 캐릭터들을 전부 불러볼까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Should I summon all available characters?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 那我們應該把所有可以召喚的角色都叫出來嗎？

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Wow!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 哦哦!

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 드디어 컷씬에 나왔다…! 난 살아있다! 살아있다고!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Finally appeared in the cut scene...! I'm alive! I'm alive!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 终于出现在删减场景里了…！我还活着！我还活着！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: It's narrow! Not everyone can be seen!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 太窄了！看不见所有人！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Camera back! Back!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 往后倒！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: This is a camera ALL! Wow, amazing!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 這是所有的相機！哦哦，太驚人了！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: It would feel like this if five people appeared on one screen.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 如果有5个人出现在一个屏幕上，会有这种感觉。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 누가 얘기하고 있는건지 확실히 알아볼 수 있어?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Can you clearly identify who is speaking?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 谁在说话，你能确定吗？

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 마음 같아서는 좀 더 이야기를 길게 이어가고 싶지만, 이 컷신은 기능 확인을 위한것이니…
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I would like to continue the conversation a little longer if I could, but this is a cutscene for functionality confirmation...
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 心情如图，我很想继续谈下去，但这是一个为了确认功能的演示...

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Let's stop chatting and proceed quickly!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 别废话了，我们快点进行吧！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The following is an individual camera!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这是单独的相机！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: POS1 ONE_1
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 位置1 一个_1

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: POS2 ONE_2
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: POS2 ONE_2

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: POS3 ONE_3
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: POS3 ONE_3 -> 第3个 ONE_3

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: POS4 ONE_4
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: POS4 一_4

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: POS5 ONE_5
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: POS5 一个_5

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Moving the camera from ONE_5 to ONE_1...
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 将相机从ONE_5移动到ONE_1...

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: It's like this right now.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 现在是 ONE_1。就是这种感觉。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 지금은 ONE_4! 카메라 이동 속도도 다양하게 바꿀 수 있지만 일단 여기서는 스킵한다!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Right now, you can change the camera movement speed in ONE_4!, but for now we'll skip that!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 现在可以改变ONE_4!相机移动速度，但现在先跳过！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Should I zoom in a bit more?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 要放大一点吗？

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 어떠냐! 이몸의 얼굴이 박력 넘치게 표현되고 있다!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: How about this! My face is expressively full of vigor!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这是什么！我这张脸突显着霸气！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Hmm, it feels like this....
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 嗯，是這種感覺嗎….

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 가장 왼쪽에 있는 아세라와 루나의 투샷을 잡고 싶으면 TWIN 카메라를 사용한다
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: If you want to capture a two-shot of Asera and Luna on the far left, use TWIN camera.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 如果想拍摄最左边的艾瑟拉和露娜的双拍，可以使用 TWIN 相机。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 이게 TWIN_1 카메라.  이렇게 하면 나와 루나만 화면에 나오지.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: This is the TWIN_1 camera. This way only me and Luna will appear on the screen.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这是 TWIN_1 摄像头。这样做的话只会显示我的和露娜的画面。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 이건 TWIN_3이다.  나와 스칼렛이 화면에 잡히지.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: This is TWIN_3. Scarlet and I are on screen.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 這是 TWIN_3。畫面中出現了我和 Scarlet。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 이건 카메라 TRIPLE_1.  아세라, 나, 에드몬이 보일거야
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: This is the camera TRIPLE_1. Asher, me, and Edmond will appear.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这是相机TRIPLE_1. 你会看到阿瑟拉、我和埃德蒙。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 이건 카메라 TRIPLE_2.  가운데를 기준으로 3명이 섰을때를 비춰준다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: This is a TRIPLE_2 camera. It illuminates when three people stand in the middle.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 這是一個三鏡頭相機。當有三個人站在中間時，它會對焦。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Is there a difference with DEFAULT? Let's take a look.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: DEFAULT和精灵有什么区别？看一下。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: This is the default camera.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 现在是默认相机。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: It's the TRIPLE_2 camera right now.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 现在是 TRIPLE_2 相机。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 카메라 기능은 거진 확인한거 같은데, 마지막으로 모두 한번 뭉쳐보자고..카메라는 ALL!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The camera feature seems to be mostly checked, so let's gather everyone and take a group photo.. Camera on ALL!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 相机功能似乎已经确认了，最后让我们全部聚在一起试试看..相机是ALL!

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Moved from POS1 to POS6.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我已经从POS1移动到POS6。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I moved from POS5 to POS9!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我移动从POS5到POS9!

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Move from POS2 to POS7.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 从POS2移动到POS7。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: POS4에서 POS8로 이동! 최대한 모두 모여봤다!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Move from POS4 to POS8! Let's try to gather everyone as much as possible!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 从 POS4 移动到 POS8！尽量让所有人都聚集在一起吧！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Camera DEFAULT... narrow!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 默认相机...窄!!!

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 아마 정신없는 화면 이겠지! 몇명 빠져보자!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Maybe it's a hectic scene! Let's try to escape!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 也许是忙乱的画面吧！让几个人出来走走！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: "Is this the end for me too..."
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我也...就到这里了吗...

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I am POS7
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我是POS7。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I am POS8
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我是POS8。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: For now, this test is over!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这次考试就到这里吧！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Good job!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 辛苦了！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: This is the Ark Point Test Scene.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这是一个弧点测试场景。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Clicking will regenerate Dana Arc Points.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 点击后，丹娜阿克点将被恢复。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: That's all!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这就是了！

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 추가 및 변경된 이모션 이펙트 테스트씬입니다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: "Additional and modified emotion effects test scene."
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 新增和更改的表情效果测试场景。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Check the added effects first.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 从添加的效果开始检查。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: THINK2
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 思考2

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: STRESS
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 压力

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: QMARK
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 问号

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Confirm.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 确认。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Check the modified effects.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 检查修改后的效果。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: THINK
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 想一想

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 心烦意乱

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: EMARK
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 唪声

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: That's all!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这就是了！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: This is a test scene.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这是一个测试场景。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Clicking will play Dana Spine
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 点击时将播放 Dana Spine

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: That's all.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 以上。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: That's... the executioner of Aldebaran, <color=#FFD34C>[Gire]</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 那個...阿爾德巴蘭的執行人，<color=#FFD34C>[吉勒]</color>。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: "Be careful, everyone."
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 大家小心。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 내 점술로도 저 녀석의 행동은 거의 예측이 안되니까.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I can't even predict that guy's behavior with my fortune telling.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我的星座也無法預測那傢伙的行為。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 그럴 땐 역시 압도적인 화력 투사가 답이지.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: In that case, an overwhelming firepower player is the answer.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 那时候当然是压倒性火力投手是关键。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 좋아. 다들 지금 처럼만 하는 거야!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Okay. Everyone will just continue like this!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 好的。大家都照着现在这样做！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Then you can definitely win!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 那你一定能赢！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Have we arrived now?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 你才到了吗？

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The mice in the wheel.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 车轮上的老鼠。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: What, me too though...
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 什么，我也是一样的...

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: What? Are you speaking now?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这是什么？你刚才说了什么？

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 투영된 상대와 대화를 하는 사례는 학계에 보고된 적 없어.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: There have been no reported cases in academia of people conversing with projected individuals.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 投影出來的對象和對話的情況在學術界尚未被報導。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 그냥 입력된 대사를 재생하는 것 아닐까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Isn't it just playing back the input dialogue?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 只是重复输入的台词吗？

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 그래, 신경 쓰지 마라. 이건 그저 혼잣말일 뿐이니까.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Okay, don't worry. It's just talking to oneself.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 不要在意，这只是我自言自语而已。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 자아. 얼른 이리 와서 같은 쥐새끼들끼리 춤을 추도록 하자.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Come here quickly so that we rats can dance together.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 赶快过来，让我们这些老鼠一起跳舞吧。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 마녀의 쳇바퀴가 빙글빙글 돌 수 있도록.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: May the witch's chakram spin around and around.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 让女巫的魔法棒旋转起来。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: ...I have arrived.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 抵达了。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Oh, really!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 啊，真的啊！

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 하아… 겨우 여기까지 오는데 몇 번이나 죽을 고비를 넘긴 거야?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Haa... How many times did you cheat death just to come this far?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 唉... 辛苦地走到这里，我又躲过了多少次死神的鬼门关？

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 노아 안에서까지 공허체들이 나타나다니 라비스타도 이젠 끝인가 봐.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Empty bodies are even appearing inside Noah, it seems Lavista's end is here too.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 挪亚内部甚至出现了空虚体，看来拉维斯塔也到头了。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 그러고보니 노아 바깥 도시에서 마지막 연락이 온 게 석 달 전이라고 들었는데.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Come to think of it, I heard that the last contact from Noah was three months ago from a city outside of Paris.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 原来是，我听说努阿最后一次是在外城接到消息已经有三个月了。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 어쩌면 이 행성에서 생존해 있는 건 이 도시 사람들 뿐인지도 모르겠네.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Maybe the only ones surviving on this planet are the city people.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 也许这颗星球上生存下来的只有这座城市里的人们。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I suddenly got depressed. Give me comfort, smile.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 突然变得沮丧了。安慰我，微笑。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 바이탈 정상, 심장 박동 수 정상, 혈압계 변동 없음.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Vitals normal, normal heart rate, no blood pressure fluctuations.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 生命体征正常，心跳正常，血压无变化。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Luna's statement of being depressed is deemed false.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 对卢娜说自己感到沮丧的声明认为是虚假的。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: So don't expect anything heavy.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 所以不要有期望，感觉沉重。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Hiing... Smile is too cold.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 嗨...微笑太冷淡了。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Anyway, is this the destination?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 总之这里就是目的地了对吧？

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#FFD34C>[Journey]</color> It's my first time coming here since my education.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#FFD34C>[旅程]</color> 教育时后是第一次来。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 맞아. 이 곳, <color=#FFD34C>[디렉의 우물]</color>을 통해서 <color=#FFD34C>[스텔라 아카이브]</color>로 진입할 거야.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Yes. I will enter the <color=#FFD34C>[Well of Direkk]</color> through this place, and head to the <color=#FFD34C>[Stellar Archive]</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 对的。通过这里，<color=#FFD34C>[迪雷克的井]</color>，将进入<color=#FFD34C>[斯特拉档案馆]</color>。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#FFD34C>[Stella Archive]</color>...
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#FFD34C>[星之归档]</color>吗…

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 데이터에 따르면 별들의 기억과 힘이 기록되어 있는 허수 차원이라고 추측됨.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: According to the data, it is speculated that the memories and power of the stars are recorded in a complex imaginary dimension.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 据资料显示，有人猜测星星记载着记忆和力量的虚数维度。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 확률은 낮지만 그곳에 가면 강력한 별의 축복을 얻을 가능성이 있어.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The probability is low, but there is a possibility to receive a powerful blessing from the stars if you go there.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 概率虽低，但如果去那里可能会得到强大星星的祝福。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: If the situation unfolds as predicted...
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 如果情况如预期发展…

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 이 절망적인 전황을 뿅! 하고 바꿀 수 있다는 거지?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Can this desperate situation change in the blink of an eye?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 你认为这种绝望的局势可以突然发生逆转吗？

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Sure.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 明白。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 라비스타에 남은 사람들에겐 우리가 마지막 희망이야.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: To the remaining people in Labistta, we are their last hope.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 在拉维斯塔剩下的人们眼中，我们是最后的希望。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: So failure is not accepted.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 所以失败是不可容忍的。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 후후, 사람들이 우릴 구원자라고 부르긴 하지만 평소 그 단어에 별 느낌은 없었는데.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Haha, people may call us saviors, but I didn't really have any special feelings about that word before.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 呵呵，人们虽然称我们为救世主，但平时对那个词并没有什么特别的感觉。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 이젠 정말로 구원자 비슷한 게 되어 버렸네.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I've become almost like a savior now.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我现在变得真的像救世主一样了。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 이번 일이 잘 풀리면 아세라 넌 정말 <color=#FFD34C>[별의 구원자]</color>의 재림…
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: If this goes well, Asra, you truly are the <color=#FFD34C>[Savior of the Stars]</color> reborn...
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 如果这次顺利解决，Asera，你将成为真正的<color=#FFD34C>[星之救世主]</color>重临…

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 아니, 그를 뛰어넘는 사람으로 불릴 지도 몰라.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: No, I might be called a person who surpasses him.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 不，可能会被称为比他更出色的人。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Come to think of it, was that your dream?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 原来那就是你的梦想？

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 축하해 아세라. 어쩌면 이번에 꿈을 이룰 지도 모르겠는 걸?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Congratulations, Asra. Perhaps you might achieve your dream this time without knowing?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 恭喜，阿塞拉。也许这次会实现梦想，谁知道呢？

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: No.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 不。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 아마 난 절대 그 사람처럼 되진 못할 거야.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Maybe I could never be like that person.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 也许我永远都无法成为那个人。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 하지만 내가 할 수 있는 일을 해야겠지.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: But I have to do what I can.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 但我应该做我能做的事情。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: That's what I learned in my <color=#FFD34C>[journey]</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这是我在<color=#FFD34C>[旅程]</color>中学到的东西。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: "Smile, how are you?"
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 微笑，情况怎么样？

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: One moment. Contacting communication officer.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 稍等片刻。正在联系关系人进行通信连接。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Signal confirmed.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 信号确认。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Here is contact manager Lisa.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这里是联系人莉莎。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 아, 보이저 구원단 분들이군요. 디렉의 우물에 도착하셨나 보죠?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Oh, I see the Voyager Rescue Team members. Have they arrived at the Dirac's Well?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 啊，看来是星际旅行者救援队的朋友们。您已经抵达了迪瑞克的井吗？

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 다행이에요. 조금만 더 늦었으면 여기도 무사하지 못했을 테니까요.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I'm lucky. If we had been a little later, we might not have survived here either.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 幸运的是。再晚一点可能就无法幸免于此了。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Astro can't even keep his promises?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: ASTRO生平也守不住？

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: How serious is the situation really?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 這種情況有多嚴重？

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 아마 <color=#FFD34C>[공허의 별]</color> 들이 우리 작전을 눈치챈 것 같아요.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: It seems like the <color=#FFD34C>[Void Stars]</color> have caught onto our plan.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 很可能<color=#FFD34C>[虚空之星]</color>们察觉到了我们的行动。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 여러분이 떠난 직후부터 <color=#FFD34C>[백작급]</color> 이상의 공허체들이 집중적으로 낙하하고 있어요.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Void essences of <color=#FFD34C>[Viscount]</color> rank and above have been intensively falling since you left.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 从您离开后的一刻起，<color=#FFD34C>[伯爵级]</color>以上的虚空体正集中降临。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: ...What about Alicia?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 阿丽西亚小姐呢？

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Are they still missing?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 你还失踪了吗？

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: That... doesn't make any sense.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 那个… 似乎完全联系不到他。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Got it.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 知道了。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Anyway, so is the application possible?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 无论如何，支持是否可行？

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Yes, it's a close call but it's still okay.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 是的，虽然有点危险，但现在还好。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 지금부터 아스트로 생텀의 남은 에너지를 모두 모아 디렉의 우물로 전송하겠습니다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: From now on, I will gather all the remaining energy of the Astro Stom and transfer it to the Direc's well.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我现在会收集ASTRO生命体的剩余能量并发送到迪瑞克的井里。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 그러면 그 곳에서 <color=#FFD34C>[스텔라 아카이브]</color>로 가는 양자 터널을 열 수 있을 거예요.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Then you should be able to open the quantum tunnel leading to the <color=#FFD34C>[Stella Archive]</color> from there.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 那么您就可以在那里打开通往<color=#FFD34C>「星际档案」</color>的量子隧道。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: ...thank you.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 谢谢。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: From now on... we'll take care of it.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 从现在开始... 由我们负责。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Yes, commander.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 是的。主人。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Hopefully... may your wishes come true.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 希望您的愿望都能实现。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: (디렉의 우물 가운데 플라네타리움에 강력한 힘이 전송된다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Powerful energy is transmitted to the Planetarium in the middle of Direk's well.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: (在迪雷克的井中心传输强大的力量到行星力场。)

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: (The planetarium starts operating and the quantum tunnel opens.)
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: (行星馆启动，量子隧道打开。)

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Quantum tunneling open.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 量子隧道開放。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Tunnel stability 67%, entry possible.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 隧道稳定性为67%，可以进入。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Now, go.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 现在，戴上，可以。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 으으… 터널에서 불길한 느낌이 펑펑 새어 나오는 걸?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Eek... A scary feeling of something ominous emanating from the tunnel?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 在隧道里感觉到一股不祥的气息冒出来了吗？

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 보나마나 공허체들이 엄청 달려들 것 같은데…
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Of course it seems like the emptiness is rushing in...
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 当然空虚体似乎会漫天而来...

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Do I have to fight again while running?
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 你必须一边奔跑一边战斗吗？

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 항상 하던 일. 평범함. A.K.A 일상. 아무것도 아님.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Always the same old routine. Mundane. A.K.A everyday life. Nothing special.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 通常做的事情。平凡。又名日常。没有什么特别的。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Don't worry. They all.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 不要担心。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I'll clear the way ahead.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我会打开一条路。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: As always.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 一如既往。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 후후, 난 그럼 우리 단장만 믿을게!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Haha, then I'll trust only our leader!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 呵呵，那我就相信我们的头目吧！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Play! Play! Asura!
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 玩！玩！阿瑟拉！

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Party.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 派对。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Let's go then.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 好的，让我们走吧。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Into the tomb of stars.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 星星的坟墓。

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 好的，我再叫一个人过来！

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这是什么！我这张脸突显着霸气！

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 嗯，是這種感覺嗎….

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这是 TWIN_1 摄像头。这样做的话只会显示我的和露娜的画面。

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 這是 TWIN_3。畫面中出現了我和 Scarlet。

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 这是相机TRIPLE_1. 你会看到阿瑟拉、我和埃德蒙。

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 這是一個三鏡頭相機。當有三個人站在中間時，它會對焦。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Is there a difference with DEFAULT? Let's take a look.
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: DEFAULT和精灵有什么区别？看一下。

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 现在是默认相机。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 카메라 기능은 거진 확인한거 같은데, 마지막으로 모두 한번 뭉쳐보자고..카메라는 ALL!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The camera feature seems to be mostly checked, so let's gather everyone and take a group photo.. Camera on ALL!
